name: @devicehub/ui
description: Shared React UI components and design tokens for DeviceHub's web client (issue #433/#435) — source-only, no build step: consumed as TSX/CSS-Modules source by apps/web's own vite/vitest pipeline, unlike @devicehub/core (pure TS, built to dist/) since a JSX/CSS build here would add complexity without a consumer that needs it.
